name: Calendar
description: Calendar cached-event screens and draft tools; signed-in HTTPS Calendar pages; provider execution and full shell composition remain incomplete.

features.description: Reads cached events and saves private day-plan drafts. Provider execution is not included in this package checkpoint.

errors.description: Calendar storage or a declared public dependency is unavailable

remediations.description: Check that Calendar and its public dependencies are enabled

features.description: Provides a bounded cache-only heartbeat read of owned events. Shared events are excluded; no provider request is made.

errors.description: Retry with only horizonHours from one to forty-eight and limit from one to twenty. These are caller inputs, not account settings.
Cached Calendar events could not be read for a check-in. Check-in delivery and Alerts integration remain outside this package checkpoint.

features.description: The package tool saves intent and untimed task additions to today or tomorrow in the saved account timezone. It is not yet connected to signed-in chat. Drafts require the current revision and public task reference adapter. Provider writes and dialog execution are not shipped in this checkpoint.

errors.description: The draft, current revision or public task adapter is unavailable.

remediations.description: Read the current draft before retrying. Check the public task adapter for task-linked edits.

features.description: Packaged Rust Day, Week and Month screens, event details and saved view choice; failed refreshes retain loaded events. The Calendar web router connects the styled installed frame behind Rust sign-in and HTTPS, with account-scoped API dispatch and sign-out. Its public static route accepts opaque-frame stylesheet requests without an Origin header while retaining host, sharing and method checks. External-calendar status, settings edits, provider writes, full shell assembly and second-device acceptance remain open.

errors.description: Calendar could not load. Check that its package is installed and enabled, then reload.
Retry Calendar. Previously loaded events remain visible.
The selected view lasts for this visit if its account preference cannot be saved.

calendar.heartbeatWindow.description: Background cache-only read of the actor's own upcoming events, with bounded results, freshness and material revision.

calendar.dayPlanDraft.description: Save evening intent and untimed task additions to the current day-plan draft for dialog review. Does not schedule events.

navigation.label: Calendar
navigation.description: Day, Week and Month views of visible cached events in the saved account timezone. Requires authenticated host frame assembly.

settings.label: Calendar
settings.description: Read-only lookahead, prep-task and time-block settings. Editing and provider execution remain unavailable.
